column4: in Gwent, Into the Breach and StS these concepts mean enemy deaths (Regis, Blood Money, Cascading Resonator, Gremlin Horn)
only Urn of Shadows (triggers another unit's Deathwish) is off

sacrifice elsewhere is mostly the Offering (kill an ally to gain units, cards or stats); only ITB suicide strikes and Stormbound explosions trade a unit for enemy damage; small pool, Runeterra "kill an ally to deal X" has no own concept
friendly_fire is mostly symmetric board-wide damage or destruction; Runeterra (deal X to an ally to...) and Stormbound (damage a friendly unit) hold the real self-damage cards
cheat_death catches can't-be-destroyed cards (Colossus, Vibranium, Lamb's Respite); Inscryption revive is only Necromancer
in Gwent, Runeterra, Faeria, Duelyst, Stormbound recycle means shuffling hand cards into the deck, Echo, Updraft or replace; only Snap, Monster Train and StS return discarded or consumed cards
in Runeterra return_to_hand mostly catches Equipment, Attach and Sleep; Runeterra Recall cards are lost with it
Inscryption summon catches unrelated sigils (Daus, Frozen Away, Ruby Heart)
condition_count is any count condition (Bloodthirst, cards played, enemies on a row), hundreds of cards per game
in Runeterra and Gwent on_ally_play mostly catches the card's own "When I'm summoned" or Deploy

positional is any place reference; flanking is Duelyst Backstab (attacking an enemy from behind); adjacency elsewhere is area damage or summons nearby; Runeterra Support and Gwent adjacent boosts are the real ones
movement in Duelyst, Faeria, ITB is enemy teleports, pushes and Flying/Charge keywords; swap in Duelyst, Gwent, Snap is stat or deck swaps
forced_movement in Faeria is Dash/self moves, in StS card-pile moves, in Inscryption self moves

lanes means any lane or location reference (410 Snap cards, Gwent row hazards, ITB tiles); only cross_lane (Inscryption split strikes) acts in another lane; Snap other-location effects have no own concept
zone_control is where cards may be played or move; terrain in Gwent, ITB, Snap is row hazards, fire tiles and locations; Inscryption territory_trigger is Sentry
Runeterra on_attack covers 943 cards, nearly all of the game (Support, summon, Reputation)
Only Stalking Broodmother (Scout) is off; Quick Attack, Celerity, Omni Strike fit.
All Overwhelm or excess damage.
Only Senna (spell kills for level up) is off.
Challenger and strike cards fit; Bloodsworn Gambler attacks a random enemy.
Tybaulk (extra spell damage) off; Rock Accelerator borderline.
Ignus (random split) and Divine Whirlwind (one unit plus Nexus) off.
Artifact Defiler destroys artifacts, not a unit; Gwent Poison counts as destroy.
All deal damage from spells or cards.
FTL counts all cards played, not spells.
on_damaged catches shields, armor, Block and player HP in most games; Stormbound/Faeria/Duelyst use it for real damage triggers; counterattack adds thorns/spikes.
disable catches stuns (temporary, not text removal); note Runeterra Recall cards are tagged silence in the library.
permanent_loss is run losses; Runeterra stat_loss/attack_zero are mostly this-round Frostbite and -X|-0; sts1 stat_loss is max HP; Arclyte (-Health) still caught.
transform is the owner's own card changing form; polymorph is enemy into weaker, steal is taking enemy units.
Duelyst hand_disruption is all stealing from the enemy deck; Stregobor and Runeterra Nab remain.
Gwent junk_cards is revealing/using the enemy deck; Marvel Snap board_clog is locations giving both sides units.
Gwent resource_gain/resource_banking/coin_economy are coins for abilities; round_carryover is Gwent Resilience units, not supply.
free_play in gwent is "Spawn and play" a new card, not my card made cheaper; cost_set in monster_train is mostly Reform (revive)
in_hand_buff elsewhere is mostly cost reduction, Fleeting or copies in hand (cheaper's job); only gwent's is near-pure boost/armor in hand
on_draw catches payoffs for drawing (and for the opponent drawing), not extra draws
generate_cards catches created cards well
misses are copies of enemy cards (about a quarter in gwent, faeria, marvel_snap, much less elsewhere); no concept separates whose card is copied
selection in runeterra and faeria is Manifest/Invoke/Discover, a choice among created cards, not picking from my deck
discard in runeterra is mostly Fleeting (about 90 of 147 cards), not discarding my own cards; on_discard keeps its discard payoffs
heal in duelyst and stormbound is mostly the General/base (player's life); regeneration in gwent is Vitality (growth), in sts1 and duelyst not unit healing
only Surrender (removes armor) is wrong
tank is a high-defence stat with no guarding, protection is any damage prevention; taunt is Provoke/Taunt/Defender
evasion is Elusive/Fearsome/Airborne/no counterattack (blocking and attacking, not untargetable); immunity in into_the_breach and inscryption is push/sigil immunity
merge_attach catches equipment and merges well
turn_start in sts1 is Block, in gwent, marvel_snap, monster_train, inscryption, into_the_breach mostly unrelated cards; in the kept games it is the player's turn/round start effects
leave_trigger in gwent is Doomed; other_leave_trigger in runeterra is Equipment and Ambush; death payoffs belong to deathfeed/lastwords
stat_condition in gwent is Inspired/Barricade/end-of-turn boosts, not a power threshold; runeterra's is Empowered, combat_damage_threshold is Reputation
